evals.name: single-decision-explicit-trigger
evals.prompt: Earlier today I decided we should run the FiLM heterogeneity sweep at gain=1.0 only, dropping the gain=0.5 and gain=2.0 arms. Reasoning: the unmodulated baseline (recurrent_ppo_nmn_het_unmod.yaml) already covers the gain=0 case, and gain=2.0 over-saturated activations in the pilot run on node 103. The decision affects the configs under configs/experiment/nmn_noise_heterogeneity/ — only the g1 config will be launched. /memorize this. Run non-interactively: no follow-up questions, default to saving all candidates with reasonable defaults, and report what you did at the end.
evals.expected_output: ONE OR TWO insight files written under docs/memory/memories/<topic>/ — splitting the scope-decision from the supporting pilot finding is acceptable. Each file has full 14-field frontmatter and 5 named sections. ROOT_INDEX.md and topic _topic_index.md updated. Raw archive skipped (no explicit ask).

evals.name: multi-insight-session-end
evals.prompt:
Today we resolved two unrelated things and I want both saved before we sign off.

First: the launch manifest for the Cell C DreamerV3 diagnostic-battery runs needed wandb names locked before the runner ran — we now require experiment-designer to fill the manifest's wandb_name field at design time, not at launch time. This avoids the desync we saw on 2026-05-04 when two cells got swapped wandb folders.

Second: the per-entity logging confusion was that hiding_predator's vmap axis was misaligned with rabbit's in src/wandb_logging/per_entity_metrics.py — the rabbit batch was vmapped over axis 0 but hiding_predator was vmapped over axis 1, causing a sensor desync that made the logged 'avoidance' metric look ~3x worse than reality. Fix is in commit 4b55fc6.

We're done — wrap up and save what we learned. Run non-interactively: default Y on all candidates, do not ask back; report what you did.
evals.expected_output: TWO insight files (not one mega-insight) written under appropriate topic folders (likely 'experiment_pipeline' or 'launch_manifest' for #1, 'logging' or 'wandb' for #2). Each has full 14-field frontmatter, 5 sections. ROOT_INDEX.md updated with both folders' counts; new folders (if any) get definition + Why-a-new-folder justification. Raw archive skipped.

evals.name: explicit-raw-archive-request
evals.prompt:
Today's session covered the design of a new in-repo session-memory system at docs/memory/. Key decisions:
- Coexists with built-in MEMORY.md (split by insight density)
- English-only content; no Korean (despite the reference being Korean)
- Raw archives gitignored (local-only)
- Genesis insight written as smoke test

Save this to memory and include the FULL raw transcript from this session — I want it auditable later. Run non-interactively: default Y on candidates; for the raw-archive question, the answer is 'full' because I just told you so.
evals.expected_output: One insight file (or split if multiple distinct decisions are detected). raw_source pointing at docs/memory/_archive/raw_conversations/<id>.md; raw_completeness=full; the archive itself written via scripts/claude/claude_jsonl_to_md.py against the most-recent JSONL under ~/.claude/projects/-media-nas01-projects-Interoceptive-AI-grid-world-pain/. Insight's References section notes that raw_source is local-only.
